Practised multiplying by 10, 100 and 1000 using place value.

Estimated products by rounding to nearby tens and hundreds.

end.parentNote: Sameer practised place-value multiplication, estimation, and simplifying products by doubling one factor and halving the other. They explained their steps aloud, including why 25 × 16 can become 50 × 8 and why 49 × 198 can be estimated as 50 × 200. A brief mix-up while counting zeros was worked through and the later estimate was corrected (correctAfterLastSeen). At home, ask them to explain one rounded multiplication and check the zeros by writing the place values.
